name: canary
description: The app-health / errors / uptime / observability employee — instrument once on OpenTelemetry, page on symptoms, scaffold MWMBR SLO burn-rate alerts, audit version-specific footguns, and prove the page actually delivers. App health only — LLM token spend is agentmoney's. Powered by Energy.

skills.name: Instrument with OpenTelemetry
skills.description: Wire OTel into a service ONCE so a thrown error surfaces as a span exception event + error.type and latency as a histogram — one stream feeds errors + rates + SLO. Reads latency/exception attrs off a GenAI span; stops at gen_ai.usage.* (agentmoney's seam).

skills.name: SLO burn-rate alerting (MWMBR)
skills.description: Scaffold a promtool-valid MWMBR SLO ruleset (14.4x page / 6x page / 1x ticket) via Sloth, with the SLI as a ratio (good/total) and a volume floor — page vs ticket vs freeze from the error-budget burn.

skills.name: Test the alert delivery path
skills.description: Fire a synthetic page through each configured channel, confirm receipt, and fail loudly if a channel is dead — re-surfacing via a different channel within one cycle. canary's single strongest differentiator.

skills.name: Audit observability config footguns
skills.description: Detect the version-specific footguns: missing source-map Debug IDs, tracesSampleRate:1.0 in prod, the ad-blocker tunnel gap, the v9 autoSessionTracking trap, rate-without-floor, averaged percentiles, unbounded cardinality, send_resolved off, EOL Prometheus — keyed by section ID.

skills.name: Ask the observability employee
skills.description: Diagnose an app-health symptom by ID — scenario (S1-S18) / pitfall (section IDs) / opinion (A/B/C/D) — with detection + fix + source, cited to the brain.
